items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Spike Lee’s dad, Bill Lee, as a – I remember him vividly being one of the bass players that came in there. I don’t remember too much drum. They didn’t have big drum sets. Maybe a snare and a hi hat, something like that, just to keep a little bit of rhythm. But Chick was the one who formulated that. I remember sitting in on that stuff.
Did you meet in the class? Or was it – how did you guys meet?
